name: Dispute Terms

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are doomed.

---
By questioning the terms of your contract, you temporarily stave off your doom at the cost of fiendish misfortune. Reduce the value of your doomed condition by 1. You roll your next attack roll, skill check, or saving throw twice and take the worse result.

Effect: Dispute Terms
